name: ElevenLabs — Text to speech
description: Renders text as speech. The text is whatever reaches this service on its input, so anything upstream that produces a string drives it; with nothing on the input the configured body is sent instead. The response is audio/mpeg, which arrives as bytes — {meta, binary} — rather than a decoded body. The voice is the last segment of the path and the format is a query parameter.
